top_signals.title: Iran rebuffs Trump's claim over Strait of Hormuz amid report of another ship being struck
top_signals.summary: Iran's deputy foreign minister says Hormuz "will remain Iranian" after Trump's claim that the waterway would soon become U.S. territory.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
